item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is the per-diagnostic convention audit of plan §56 (lead comment c-20261008-s56-selene-cocos2): using SELENE COCOS 2 as reference, compare each magnetic diagnostic family's measured values at reference shots with the SELENE reconstruction at the sensor positions and record sign, orientation and 2π factor with evidence and confidence, for flux loops, pickup coils, the Ip Rogowski coils, the diamagnetic loop and the toroidal-field measurement, plus each profile coordinate convention; docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-discovery-completion/diagnostic-convention-audit.html covers all five magnetic families and the profile coordinates across 132 channel entries.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commits [7ffd1a5a2, 8a12305d0, 705ab2a10, ead7c9ea, a12126ba5, fbe4cbd31, 4ca4f650]; baseline_suite and after_suite are both empty at manifest.md:21-22, so no added-failure count is derivable for this run.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-discovery-completion/ and docs/figures/jt60sa-discovery-completion/; git diff --stat 9db53ba0..4ca4f650 touches only diagnostic-convention-audit.html and jt60sa-diagnostic-conventions.json, both inside the declared scope, and no figure was produced.

justifications.durability: the artifact is a schema-versioned JSON (schema jt60sa-diagnostic-conventions/1) plus an HTML fragment, but no committed test or loader reads either; the only assertions are the run's own one-shot inline gate recorded at manifest.md:15, so a dropped channel, a changed factor or a schema change would redden nothing until node 2's loader test exists.
justifications.evidence: the committed-head gate reproduces: my independent recount of the JSON gives 132 channels, 54 flux mapped disagree, 34 pickup mapped agree, 26 unmapped, and the HTML carries exactly 132 data rows (review-repro-gate.log EXIT=0); the artifact cites two shots with SELENE receipts and the versioned imas-alambic-jt60sa v0.2.0-rc3 bundle by hashes, but several values are legitimately left undetermined (diamagnetic geometry, extra DD indices, profile coordinate sign) and the toroidal-field amplitude agreement is specific to the E101011 example, so the evidence covers the audited quantities without closing every value.
justifications.fit: the seven commits use conventional docs(magnetics)/docs subjects with bodies that state the mechanism and carry no plan, section or ticket label, matching the evidence-fragment idiom at docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-discovery-completion/jt60sa-cocos-study.html.
justifications.goal_fidelity: all five magnetic families named in the plan (flux loops, pickup coils, Ip Rogowski, diamagnetic loop, toroidal-field measurement) and the profile coordinates appear in jt60sa-diagnostic-conventions.json:families and the html sections at lines 6, 80, 131, 147, 155 and 161; every entry carries a confidence and an evidence field.
justifications.reuse: the audit reads flux-loop and pickup identities, DD geometry and the COCOS 17 rules from the read-only imas-alambic-jt60sa bundle rather than re-deriving them, per plan comment c-20261008-s56-ambix-authority, and adds no loader or mapping capability of its own; its own SELENE snapshot measurements fill only the Rogowski, diamagnetic, toroidal and profile gaps the bundle leaves.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 9db53ba0..4ca4f650 shows exactly the two declared evidence files, 7764 insertions, nothing outside the fence.
